name: Missed rebates finder
summary: Finds Medicare, DVA and health fund rebates a clinic has not been paid, from its practice system and its ledger, and lists them for a person to check. Crons read and list only; nothing is lodged, chased or changed.

crons.name: pull
crons.summary: Read invoices and their items from Cliniko and payments from Xero.

crons.name: flag
crons.summary: List open rebate-item invoices with no payment in Xero for a person to check (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Reads only. The flag list is written to this workflow's own store and reaches nobody outside the business.

cliniko.covers: invoice list and invoice items, read only; no claim status

xero.covers: payments read only, matched to invoice numbers

gaps: No mapped platform exposes Medicare, DVA or health fund claim status. Cliniko's API has no claim endpoint and Tyro Health is not mapped, so a person checks each claim in Cliniko.
Claims run, lodgement and chasing have no mapped operation. Cliniko's docs describe no batch claim run and its API has no lodge call; Xero has no payer lodgement. These stay with the clinic.
Eligibility and rebate rule checks are not mapped. The HiCaps help pages were not captured (every URL returned the same homepage), and HiCaps has no platform folder in the kit.
Xero invoice numbers are assumed to match Cliniko invoice numbers, because Cliniko pushes invoices to Xero. Unconfirmed in a live account.
Confirm the workflow steps and platform coverage with the business before enabling its crons.
This finder has no live operation, so the queue and approval path is not exercised. Adding a lodge or chase step later needs a mapped live operation first.
Both adapters are docs-only until a Cliniko sandbox and a Xero demo company prove the field names.
Cliniko invoices are read up to 1,000 per run (10 pages of 100). Older invoices beyond that are not read.
